note: Answers are checked against the Jujutsu Kaisen wiki as crawled. 'expect_docs' lists pages any correct retrieval must surface; 'expect_text' lists substrings that must appear somewhere in the returned passages or facts. Questions are grouped by what they exercise, because a suite that only asks lookups cannot tell a good retriever from a lucky one.

questions.question: Which technique lets someone swap the positions of two people by clapping?
What ability lets a sorcerer see the flow of cursed energy in perfect detail?
What is the strengthened punch that occurs when an attack lands within a fraction of a second of cursed energy?
What is the contract a jujutsu user forms with themselves or another to gain power?
questions.note: Originally phrased 'a promise made in exchange for a restriction', which retrieved Heavenly Restriction instead. That was a bad question, not a bad retrieval: in this series a Heavenly Restriction also trades a restriction for power, so the question had two correct answers. Rephrased rather than tuning the retriever to prefer one reading of an ambiguous prompt.

questions.question: Every Cursed Technique of Sukuna
questions.note: Resolved to the generic `Cursed Technique` page rather than to Sukuna, because 'cursed technique' is the longer alias. Corrected 2026-08-19 under the owner's taxonomy (HANDOVER Phase 1): a cursed technique is an Innate or Inherited Technique only. Malevolent Shrine is his Domain Expansion (`type = Domain Expansion` -> class `domain`) and Black Flash is Taijutsu (`type = Taijutsu` -> class `physical`); both are jujutsu abilities, not cursed techniques, so the engine's class filter correctly excludes them. The bank note on jjk-set-02 says the same. They were removed from expect_members rather than widening the keep-set, which would have inflated every other technique roster.
